nom: FARMACY Green Clean Juicy Gel Cleanser

avis.texte: This cleanser was just okay for me. It cleansed my skin well enough, but I wasn't a huge fan of the scent and normally that stuff doesn't bother me. I double cleanse and that seemed to work better.
It removes impurities very easy. Adding this cleanser to my routine was a game changer. It takes care very easy of make up as well, which is my hardest point. Love it and would recommend!

avis.titre: Fresh, gentle, and doesn't strip my skin
avis.texte: This gel claims to remove SPF and make-up, but I'm always using two-step cleansing method for my skin. This one is perfect for second step. I've been really enjoying this cleanser! It has a lightweight gel texture that lathers just enough to leave my skin feeling clean without that tight, stripped feeling afterward. I have combination skin that's easily dehydrated, and this hasn't irritated my skin or caused any dryness. It also has a fresh, citrusy, juicy scent that's pleasant without being overwhelming. If you wear heavy makeup and sunscreen, I'd still recommend using a cleansing balm first, but as an everyday cleanser, this has been great. It leaves my skin feeling fresh, clean, and comfortable every time.
Another great Farmacy product. Was a long time user of the Green Clean cream to foam cleanser, but stopped because it was so thick and difficult to get out of the squeeze tube

I actually like this cleanser. Having moringa and coconut water in the ingredients impressed me. The scent is very subtle, it lathers well and feels so clean and refreshing every after wash. The only thing I noticed is it dries put my skin a little bit.

I usually have combination skin, but this has brought my skin back to normal texture. My skin is so rejuvenated and moisturized after using this product. I usually use antibacterial soap to wash my face, due to other face washes causing me to break out

I am loving this product. I was kind of hesitant because I like a full beat and didn't think it would be able to remove all of my makeup but it did and effortlessly. I love this cleanser it left my skin feeling fresh and clean but still hydrated. I hate when cleansers make my skin feeling fresh dry and tight, I didn't get that from this. It was a force in removing my makeup but gentle enough for everyday use. I will definirely be repurchasing. Loving the Farmacy brand!

avis.titre: Do not use this if you have sensitive skin
avis.texte: I bought this hoping for a slightly deeper clean than the gentle care (my usual holy grail) it immediately burned the crap out of my skin like BADLY it hurts and im so disappointed I have never not loved a farmacy product but honestly I don't know why this needed to exist it doesn't seem much different from the regular green other than that it burns like acid. The only thing I do like is the bottle. Please put the gentle green in this 🙏.

avis.titre: Perfect for my combination oily, acne-prone skin!
avis.texte: **5/5 Stars – Perfect for my combination oily, acne-prone skin!** This Juicy Gel Cleanser is a total winner. The light, refreshing gel texture cleans deeply without stripping my skin or leaving it tight. It effectively removes oil, dirt, and makeup while keeping my barrier happy. My T-zone stays more balanced, breakouts haven't worsened, and my skin feels calm, soft, and hydrated afterward. No irritation, just fresh and clean. Love the soothing feel, definitely repurchasing!

I had to give it some time to see if I actually like the cleanser and I do. It hasn't broken me out and is a very good add on to my routine. After incorporating it into my daily routine, it is a cleanser that I'd repurchase.

avis.titre: A clean that I can get behind.
avis.texte: I was gifted this product in exchange for my honest review. I enjoyed this gel cleanser as it isn't artificially or heavily fragranced, it has a great consistency/texture - not too thick or watery. This cleanser didn't leave my skin feeling dry or raw, it left it feeling smooth and refreshed.

avis.titre: Wonderful cleanser with a delicious smell!
avis.texte: I have been using this product for about 3 weeks now, morning and night and it is amazing. It smells so refreshing and leaves my face feeling clean without being dried out. I have sensitive skin and this has not irritated it - in fact, I have noticed an overall improvement since beginning its use. My skin feels more hydrated and less red. I highly recommend giving this a shot.
I am particular about cleansing balm residue and this one is great!

This was my first time using Farmacy cleanser and this product was so much better compared to other options I've tried before. I like the texture consistency and most of all the way it makes my skin feel afterward.

I used this as a second cleanse after the cleansing balm if I wore makeup or sunscreen during the day or on its own when I did not. It comes in a convenient pump container and it is a clear gel cleanser that smells like a fancy spa. My face feels squeaky clean after using it!
I'm amazed at this product. I wanted to really see how well my skin responds to this. It's non stripping and healthy ingredients. That is why I love Farmacy Beauty.

I have been loving the farmacy green clean juice gel cleanser. It leaves my skin feeling soft , clean and refreshed without stripping it. The scent is so fresh like a light herbal tea and it makes my skincare routine feel extra refreshing. Plus it's gentle enough for all skin types . Definitely a cleanser I will keep reaching for

I received this product for free in return for my honest opinion. That being said, I have been enjoying this gel cleanser a lot. I love the mild smell and the lather that it produces. It doesn't strip my skin, cleans my face from oil and light make up and leaves my face feeling so nice! I did notice if I wear waterproof mascara or heavy make up I do need to double cleanse with an oil cleanser first to really get it all off. Overall it has been a great replacement to my normal cleanser and I will purchase it again!

This cleanser makes my face feel so clean and smooth! It doesn't dry out my face and it feels super clean! It's gentle enough for My 7yo daughter has used it occasionally when she wants to do skincare with Mama. LOVE this cleanser! I will be buying more and trying their other products soon! Even though the cap was broken when I received it, I was able to use a cap from my other cleanser and it works just fine.

I love this facial cleanser so much. I've been using it for several years now and it never disappoints. It makes my skin squeaky clean, but doesn't strip it. My husband even loves using this cleanser and asks for it!

I was already a fan of Farmacy's green clean cleansing balm, so was thrilled to test their green clean juicy gel cleanser. It did not disappoint - this cleanser is gentle and doesn't leave skin leaving tight. The pump works well and the bottle feels solid.

avis.titre: Goes on smooth and suds up nice
avis.texte: I love this cleanser! It smells amazing, really makes my face feel clean.
This cleanser is so refreshing and it makes my skin feel squeaky clean!

I really like this product….like a lot. I wear waterproof makeup and it's very hard to come off with basic makeup remover. The product helps make the remaining makeup come off and helps your skin feel clean and refreshed. Will definitely buy again.

Seriously, one of the best cleansing washes I've used in a while. For my skin to be this cleansed and hydrated after one wash is amazing. I love the fact that it didn't strip my skin, but I could definitely feel how clean it is would 1000% recommend and definitely adding as a staple in my routine.

avis.titre: Fresh, Gentle & Perfect for Everyday Use
avis.texte: I've been using this cleanser every morning and evening, and it has quickly become one of my favorites. The lightweight gel texture feels refreshing, creates a soft lather, and removes makeup residue, sunscreen, and daily impurities without stripping my skin. My face feels clean, soft, and hydrated after every wash. I also love the fresh scent and how gentle it is, even on days when my skin feels more sensitive. It's a great everyday cleanser that leaves my skin looking healthy and balanced. I would definitely purchase it again and highly recommend it.
I used this one time only. After being on my face for a few minutes it made my face all itchy. Had to go scrub it off immediately

I needed some time to see how I liked it. And I can stay that I LOVE THIS CLEANSER. Leaves my skin nice moisturized and honestly it has been looking a lot less inflamed and less red. I have sensitive skin and it seemed to do well with mine. However my sister has overly sensitive skin and it did not work for her

I love Farmacy products and this one is no different! I have combination skin (T-zone is oily, everywhere else dry) and it is hard finding a face cleanser that is just right- cleans oily pores but doesn't strip the skin. It cleanses well, but it doesn't dry out my skin. It's gentle and it's pretty good at removing makeup and sunscreen. It smells pleasantly tropical but the scent isn't overpowering. It's a good size and I LOVE that it has a pump! Most of the mid to high end cleansers I've tried are squeeze tubes, so this is a really nice feature. A little goes a long way, but once I'm (eventually) out I'd definitely consider repurchasing :)

I really enjoyed using this cleaner. I have sensitive, acne prone skin and I have not experienced any breakouts or skin sensitivity while using this product for the past month. I love that a little goes a long way! It has a light herbaceous scent, but I don't see any added fragrance in the ingredient list which I love. It lathers up easily and really cleans my skin, including makeup and sunscreen. I use it as part of my double cleansing routine and it has become a staple product in my routine.

avis.titre: Fresh, gentle, and perfect for everyday use
avis.texte: I've been using this cleanser morning and night, and it leaves my skin feeling clean, fresh, and hydrated without making it feel tight or dry. The gel texture is lightweight, lathers nicely, and rinses off easily. It removes everyday dirt and excess oil while being gentle on my skin. I also enjoy the fresh scent. I haven't found any downsides so far and would definitely purchase it again.

avis.titre: I will definitely be buying over and over
avis.texte: I was really impressed with this cleanser! It's a lightweight gel texture that lathers on smoothly on your skin. I love that unlike other cleansers, this one did NOT leave my skin feeling dry/tight. It left my skin feeling so clean and fresh! It works great with removing make up making the process easier and faster. I also really love the packing, it looks like it belongs in a spa! lol

I'm in love with this face wash. It smells incredible- like juicy mandarin oranges with a hint of spice. It also cleans my skin really nicely and doesn't leave it tight and dry, even if I don't put lotion on which is a lifesaver in the summer.
Love farmacy products. I used buy them all the time and this cleanser is awesome. I love the way it feels on my skin. It's great!
Lightweight, great cleanser. This leave an amazing clean feeling. Light yet extremely amazingly clean. No weird residue or dryness but instead a really refreshing clean.

The FARMACY Green Clean Juicy Gel Cleanser is a refreshing, non-stripping daily cleanser designed to deeply purify pores while locking in essential hydration. Formulated as a direct extension of the brand's iconic Green Clean line, this product expands their texture portfolio into a lightweight gel that transforms into a silky lather.Core Formula HighlightsThe formulation prioritizes farm-sourced, nutrient-dense ingredients that balance skin barriers while removing impurities:Coconut Water: Infuses the skin with natural electrolytes to revitalize moisture levels.Moringa Extract: Powerfully washes away stubborn debris, daily environmental buildup, and leftover SPF.Upcycled Mango: Conditions and softens the complexion to promote a healthy-looking, radiant glow.Inulin: Acts as a moisture-retaining humectant to ensure the skin balances perfectly without feeling tight.

I always love Farmacy packaging, and this one is no exception. This is a beautiful minimalist bottle which will look nice on your counter. This smells like something you might find at a spa and lathers nicely. I found that this did dry my skin out, so I will not continue to use it.

avis.titre: I love Farmacy's Green Clean Line
avis.texte: I've been really impressed with this cleanser. It has a lightweight gel texture that lathers nicely and leaves my skin feeling clean without that tight, stripped feeling other cleansers can cause. It also removes makeup easily, and my skin always feels soft and hydrated afterward. I also love the pump packaging and the scent is light and fresh without being overpowering. Definitely a product I'll repurchase!

I really enjoy the gel formulation. The cleanser has a great lather. It feels gentle on my skin and removed all the makeup and debris from the day. This did not leave my skin feeling tight , irritated, or dried out. It did a great job cleansing and I did not feel like I needed to do a second cleanser that I normally do.

I had the pleasure to try Farmacy's Green Clean Juicy Gel cleanser for about three weeks . I had no idea what to expect but I was so pleasantly surprised with this face wash! This cleanser is made with moringa to refresh your skin, it also contains coconut water to support your skins natural moisture balance, theres also up cycled mango to deliver essential nutrients, and inulin to replenish hydration. I used it to effortlessly remove my makeup. Another plus is that it has SPF , leaves skin soft + energized. It's made for all skin types. I would definitely restock when I am out !!

I have skin that is prone to redness, so I tend to prefer gentle products. The switch from my former face wash to this one was seamless- no breakouts, no irritation or dryness, just a nice gentle clean. The pump dispenses the perfect amount for your entire face and the smell is lovely; spa-like, botanical and relaxing. I highly recommend this face wash and will absolutely be looking into other products from this brand!
I apply twice every day. It takes time to adjust and absorb, but it really works with my skin

I have sensitive skin and this cleanser did not dry out or irritate my skin at all. Smell is pleasant and works well to cleanse the face while leaving the skin soft and hydrated. I love this brand and cleanser and will definitely recommend and repurchase once this one is done

Product did fine but I wasn't impressed. It cleaned my face just fine and removed makeup residue but I did notice that I had a few more blemishes than with other cleansers so may not be best for acne prone skin but should be fine for normal skin. May be drying for dryer skin as its close to a squeaky clean feel.

I've been really enjoying this cleanser. It leaves my skin feeling clean and refreshed without making it feel dry or tight afterward. The gel texture is lightweight, lathers nicely, and gives my skin a healthy, fresh feeling. It's become one of my favorite everyday cleansers because it's gentle and keeps my skin feeling soft.

I love this cleanser! I use it after taking my makeup off— although it does a nice job taking makeup off itself. It smells fresh, leaving my skin clean— not overly dry. I live in a super dry environment so it's important to me to have good balance- will absolutely be refilling this cleanser!

(i received this product for free in exchange for an honest review) i truthfully was not expecting much from this product because i already have a strong commitment to my cerave hydrating facial cleanser, i have been a loyal user of my cerave for years because it was the only gentle face cleanser that didn't dry out my skin or cause me to break out in hives afterwards, but low and behold this Farmacy Green Clean Juicy Cleanser exceeded my expectations. it is extremely light, the fragrance reminds me of eucalyptus but not overpowering at all, it's a very clean smell, the texture is a lightweight gel, not sticky or overly thick & oh my gosh it cleans so well. i have found myself reaching for this and completely forgot about my OG cerave. this product doesn't strip my natural oils and actually cleans my face. my face isn't dry or flaky after i use it. random bumps of redness doesn't start to appear nor do i get itchy. i have combo dry skin & a little sensitive. but this is definitely my new favorite cleanser.
This product is amazing! I love how smooth it feels on your skin and leaves your skin feeling both cleansed and soft!

This is a great gentle cleanser that I think anyone could use. I like their cleansing balm so I was excited to try this too. I did into know it existed. It does a good job making your face clean but does not feel stripping or drying. Doesn't give you that tight feeling after you wash with it. I think it would be great for teens and adults and for a normal skin type. I like the gel formula and the way jt feels on the skin. I would recommend.
Such a nice cleanser. I'll be honest though, it doesn't really stand out for me as far as clean cleansers go. I still prefer my other brand for its scent and lather.
I loved this cleanser. A little bit went a long way it lathered very well and it didnt leave my skin feeling stripped.
This cleanser is really refreshing and gentle. I like that it didn't strip my skin and left it feeling smooth

Farmacy Beauty's Green Clean Juicy Gel Cleanser is a great, fresh addition to my skincare routine. The consistency is light and not runny. The cleanser lathers well and rinses easily. My skin feels clean but not stripped. I also appreciate that the gel cleanser smells clean. there is no artificial or overpowering scent

I've been using this cleanser for about a month now and I really love it! The smell is clean and reminds me of a spa like smell but not over powering or heavily fragranced. It doesn't strip my skin like other cleansers do, it's the perfect non active non drying daily cleanser!

The cleanser has a clear gel texture and produces a rich, satisfying foam. It cleans my face well without making my dry skin feel tight or dry afterward. The scent is very pleasant, with soft hints of citrus and fresh leafy notes. It is gentle and not overpowering. I think this cleanser is perfect for simple everyday face washing, especially after using makeup remover. It leaves my skin feeling clean, fresh, and comfortable. Highly recommended!

avis.titre: Gentle cleansing with spa like scent
avis.texte: I received this product for review. I have used the cleansing balms and other cleansers from this brand in the past and this is by far my favorite. My skin feels hydrated and plump after using like I just left the spa. This new luxurious cleanser is my new go to!
I liked the texture and smell of the cleanser. Was gentle on my face too

This gel cleanser is simple but effective! It has a light natural scent that doesn't irritate. It doesn't froth or foam, but feels lightweight on the skin while still giving it a full cleanse. My skin doesn't feel dry or tight afterwards, but feels clean and hydrated.
! It leaves my skin feeling clean, fresh, and soft without drying it out. It removes sunscreen and everyday buildup easily, and the gel texture feels amazing. Definitely a new staple in my routine
It was very refreshing and it left my skin feeling hydrated after cleaning. This is definitely a keeper especially in the hot summer. On the other hand I'll be ready to tackle the cold winter

I received this product to review. This cleanser works well to remove impurities while leaving skin feeling very hydrated and plumped. The scent has a very spa like smell which makes the experience feel even more luxurious. If your looking to treat yourself and splurge a little on a cleanser I highly recommend this one as it brings the spa right into your home.

I double cleanse daily so I like to use cleansers that are gentle and non drying. This cleanser fits the bill and doesn't leave me feeling like my skin is tight after washing my face. I can't speak to how well it removes makeup since my oil cleanser does that. But it is good at removing any oily residue left behind after oil cleansing.

I really enjoyed trying this Farmacy green clean juicy gel cleanser. I've been using it consistently for a little bit over two weeks and I'm just continuously impressed. My face feels genuinely so squeaky clean perfect after a long day wearing heavy makeup and my favorite part is it doesn't irritate my skin, which is why I waited a little bit to do my reviews because sometimes it doesn't always happen right away, but I can truly say after prolonged use my skin still feels healthy and amazing and not stripped of the natural oils

avis.titre: My face is so clean and moisturized!
avis.texte: As a dry skin girlie who uses many actives, I needed a product that would cleanse the skin without being stripping. The ultimate goal was for my cleanser to do some of the heavy lifting when it came down to moisture. This product has given me that by never leaving my fact tight or dry. My face always feels moisturized which makes me believe that the next steps in my skincare regimen will follow suit and give me the moisture I need for the remainder of the day.

I love this cleaner as well as their cleansing bomb! I'm not surprised that I love this just as much. The consistency feels amazing and not stripping on your skin at all. This is a great I'm going to the gym. Let me quick wash my face in the morning or a second cleanse after your oil cleanser I love this.

Pros:made with moringa and coconut water this cleanser feels like you treated yourself to a spa day! It does not strip your skin and is gentle enough to remove impurities for glowing skin. It has a pleasant scent that some might think is too strong but I love! It has a pump dispenser which has a lock which I love because I travel a bit. I've noticed my skin feels smooth and pores are still there but oil is at bay.

I have sensitive skin that can become irritated very easily, so I'm always cautious when trying a new cleanser. I was pleasantly surprised by how amazing this cleanser is. It thoroughly cleansed my skin without leaving it feeling stripped or causing any irritation. Instead, my skin felt clean, soft, balanced, and refreshed after every use. I use this cleanser as the second step in my double cleansing routine, and it does an excellent job of removing any remaining impurities while leaving my complexion feeling hydrated and comfortable. The gel transforms into a rich, silky lather that feels luxurious, and my skin always looks healthy and radiant afterward. I also really appreciate that the packaging is recyclable, making it a more environmentally conscious choice. This has become a staple in my skincare routine, and I highly recommend it, especially for those with sensitive skin.

avis.titre: A great addition to my cleansing routine
avis.texte: I've really been enjoying this cleanser, especially as the second step in a double cleanse. I use the Farmacy Green Clean Cleansing Balm first to remove makeup and sunscreen, then follow with the Green Clean Juicy Gel Cleanser. They pair together perfectly. The gel cleanser lathers nicely, rinses clean, and leaves my skin feeling fresh without that tight, stripped feeling that some cleansers can cause. It removes any remaining residue from the cleansing balm while still feeling gentle enough for everyday use. My skin feels clean, soft, and comfortable afterward—not squeaky or dry. If you're already using the Green Clean Cleansing Balm, I think this makes an excellent follow-up cleanser. It's become a staple in my evening routine.

I received this product for free in exchange for my honest review. I've been using the Green Clean Juicy Gel Cleanser every morning since I got it, and I honestly really like it. I already used the Farmacy moisturizer religiously before trying this cleanser, so I was excited to add it to my routine. They work really well together. The cleanser leaves my skin feeling clean without drying it out, and I love the cooling, refreshing feel especially in the morning. I have sensitive, dry skin, and Farmacy products have always worked well for me. This cleanser has been no exception. I would definitely buy this again and would absolutely recommend it to anyone with sensitive or dry skin looking for a gentle cleanser that actually feels good to use.

avis.titre: Fresh cleanser that leaves my skin feeling clean without dry
avis.texte: I've been using this cleanser as the second step in my evening routine after removing my makeup. The gel texture feels lightweight, lathers nicely, and rinses off easily without leaving any residue. My skin feels clean, refreshed, and comfortable afterward instead of tight or stripped. I also like that it has a light, fresh scent that isn't overpowering. After using it consistently, my skin has stayed balanced and soft. I would definitely keep this in my skincare routine.

After using this cleanser for a month, I can say that it makes my face feel clean every wash. The gel lathers and cleanse my face very well. There's a slight smell of the moringa that is part of the ingredients and it smells like when you go to spa and you right away feels relax.

I received this Green Clean Juicy Gel Cleanser from Farmacy in exchange for my honest review. I really enjoy this cleanser. It cleans my skin without feeling dry or leaving a residue. It is not harsh and seems safe to use daily. I also enjoy the packaging, the pump locks so there is no spilling or loss of product. I will continue to use this product.

avis.titre: I would buy this product again and again !
avis.texte: This was a really good facials cleaning product easy to use and definitely takes the makeup off like it should doesn't burn your eyes either I would highly recommend this anyone !

First off I have VERY dry skin, I has psoriasis and eczema, so I have to be pretty careful of what I use on my face. This stuff is so good! It helps with the dry patches on my face and doesn't irritate! I am definitely a life time customer!

I absolutely love this cleanser it will be my new cleanser from now own. My skin feels clean and looks absolutely amazing. I cannot wait to try the rest of the line. Very budget friendly and highly recommend.

I use an oily jelly make up remover that leaves my skin feeling slippery and my pores clogged. This cleanser does a wonderful job at removing any makeup left behind from the first cleanser without leaving my face completely stripped and feeling dry. My face feels thoroughly cleansed and my skin feels plump and has a good shine to it. It is a clear gel like consistency and has a slight smell to it but nothing overpowering, mostly a fresh kind of scent. I received this item for free in exchange for an honest review.

I have combo oily acne prone skin and I wear a lot of sunscreen/makeup! I have been testing this out as my evening cleanser after a balm cleanser and as my morning face wash as well. I love it for both situations. It is not extra hydrating or nourishing but for my combo skin the level of cleanliness it gives me is perfect. Might be too drying for drier skin type.
I love this product! I wash my face am & pm leaves my skin so fresh and hydrated. It purifies and deep cleans my face

I really enjoyed this green clean juicy gel cleanser. The fragrance was beautiful and lasting. I felt it thoroughly cleaned my skin. No residue after rinsing. It had just the right amount of latter rinsed off very easily.And I felt my skin looked more vibrant after using, and it was perfectly squeeky clean

I'm a Farmacy cleansing balm fan, so I was excited to try this out! The scent is very light; a little citrusy! It's a nice lightweight gel cleanser, that has a moderate lather. Did not sting my eyes! I think it pairs great with the cleansing balm for a nice double cleanse, as I wouldn't just use this one to remove my full-face of makeup. I think all skin types would enjoy this one — I'm normal to dry and my face didn't feel stripped or like there was a residue left behind. Recommend! *Received free in exchange for honest review

I really enjoyed this product, the texture of the cleanser is amazing - my skin feels so clean and refreshed after using. It smells clean but not overly strong. I will typically pair the gel cleaner with a foam cleanser for a dual cleanse.

This is a wonderful, mild face wash suitable for all skin types. It was very refreshing, cleansed well, but also didn't strip my skin completely. I have dry skin, and this washed my face well and still left my skin feeling very comfortable.

I've been really impressed with the Green Clean Juicy Gel Cleanser! It leaves my skin feeling clean, fresh, and hydrated without that tight, stripped feeling that some cleansers cause. The gel texture is lightweight, lathers nicely, and easily removes dirt, oil, and everyday makeup. After using it consistently, my skin feels softer, smoother, and looks brighter. It's gentle enough for daily use and has become a staple in my skincare routine. I highly recommend it to anyone looking for a cleanser that's effective, refreshing, and leaves your skin feeling healthy and balanced.

While I received this product as a free sample in exchange for a review, I can honestly say this cleanser will be purchased again once I run out. I love the clean feeling this cleanser leaves your face with. It is very easy to apply, rinses easily, and has a nice cooling effect as well. You don't need much, so this bottle does last a very long time, which is another plus to the product. Overall, I am very surprised and happy with this product.
This is a good cleansing gel. It cleanses the skin well, has a pleasant scent and isn't too runny, which is another plus! What's more, it doesn't dry out the skin and leaves it feeling soft.
This makes my face feel so clean but not tight or dry, would highly recommend! Thanks to Farmacy for providing this product in exchange for my honest review.

avis.titre: Great cleanser from a trustworthy brand
avis.texte: I typically use the Farmacy cleanser with moringa and papaya. This was the only travel size cleanser I could purchase from the brand, and I love it! The green clay really helps my pores, by exfoliating and reducing them. The scent is just as pleasant as my typical cleanser. And there is no over dryness using this one either! My skin feels just as clean and refreshed! It's just as effective as my usual cleanser, and I'm glad I now have a backup! For the Farmacy brand, it's not an exorbitant cost, but it is a higher-priced brand overall.

Honestly, this is such a good cleanser, and a little bit really goes a long way. It leaves my skin super hydrated through the night, which is exactly why I love using it in my evening routine. It gets my skin totally clean without making it feel stripped or tight at all.Just a heads-up, it definitely has a scent to it. If your skin is super sensitive to fragrances, it might not be the best fit for you. My skin is pretty sensitive and it doesn't bother me, but I do have eczema patches around my eyes. I make sure to avoid that area completely because of the essential oil smell, just because I don't want to risk triggering a flare-up. Overall, I'd absolutely buy this again and highly recommend it as a night cleanser!
This product leaves my skin feeling flawless, soft, and radiant.
This is a lightweight cleanser - great for summer months since the scent is very refreshing and the gel texture helps clean the skin well. Might be a bit drying during winter months.

I used to think that cleaners really didn't matter in your overall skin care routine because all of the other products I was going to use them on my face were actually going to benefit me more than the cleanser. Boy was I wrong! The Farmacy Green Clean cleanser is the perfect first or second cleanser. I typically use a cleansing bomb and then go in with some type of gel cleanser afterward, but I actually ended up using the Farmacy cleanser for the first step and it worked just as good in getting all of my makeup off. It has a slight sent that feels natural and not overly fragrant at all. This is a great morning or evening cleanser. Highly recommend!

Loved this cleanser have been using it for over 2 weeks and I can see the difference , this product feels light weight leaves skin refreshed without it feeling heavy , face feels smooth , hydrated , refreshed love love love Pairing it with my papaya make up remover from farmacy

This cleanser claims to clear your pores and be gentle. I don't know if it made much difference to my pores, maybe it will over a longer time. But it is gentle, doesn't dry out my skin and hasn't made me break out. It does have a smell, similar to turmeric or rosemary. While not unpleasant, it may bother people with a sensitivity to smells or fragrance. Overall it does the job well, but I do have a gripe with the packaging.The bottle dispenser locks in place which is great, but when I push down, it gets stuck and I have to manually pull it back up all of the way. Some of the cleanser ends up around the rim of the dispenser after pulling it up and makes things a bit messy. If that issue could be fixed, i'd rate it 5 stars.

I've been using the Farmacy Green Clean Juicy Gel Cleanser and I'm really impressed! It has a lightweight gel texture that lathers nicely and leaves my skin feeling clean, fresh, and soft without drying it out. It removes oil and everyday impurities really well, and my skin feels balanced after every wash. The fresh scent is also a nice bonus. Great for daily use!

This is a great daily facial cleanser that doesn't strip your skin dry, and it is so gentle. I haven't had any reactions or breakouts like I do with some cleansers. It has a nice, light scent that doesn't linger after rinsing.

avis.titre: Great Product For Cleansing Congested Skin
avis.texte: The product was great for my time of the month breakouts. It helped clean my skin without it being so harsh. Although, I had a reaction to the product, I would recommend this product.

(received product free in exchange for review) This is truly one of the most gentle cleansers I've tried that doesn't leave my skin feeling stripped at all, but still does a great job of cleaning my skin. I use this cleanser as part of my double cleansing routine at night, and alone in the morning, and I love it for both! Highly recommend!

avis.titre: I would buy this product again
avis.texte: I received this product for free. I've been using the Farmacy Green Clean Juicy Gel Cleanser for a few weeks, and it has become one of my favorite everyday cleansers. The lightweight gel texture feels refreshing on the skin and lathers into a soft foam that effectively removes oil, dirt, sunscreen, and other daily impurities without making my skin feel tight or dry. I really like how clean and balanced my skin feels after every wash. It leaves my face feeling soft, hydrated, and refreshed rather than stripped. The formula with moringa and coconut water gives my skin a healthy, fresh look, and I've noticed my complexion looks smoother and less dull with regular use. The pump bottle is convenient and hygienic, and one pump is enough to cleanse my entire face, so the product lasts a long time. It has a light, fresh scent that's pleasant without being overwhelming. I have combination skin, and it helps control excess oil while still keeping my skin comfortable. Overall, this is a gentle yet effective cleanser that's perfect for daily use. If you're looking for a cleanser that thoroughly cleans your skin while maintaining its natural moisture, I definitely recommend giving this one a try. It's a great addition to any skincare routine.

I have combination skin that tends to lean more on the dry side and I am always looking for facial cleansers that aren't too harsh or drying. I appreciate Farmacy products because they use amazing clean ingredients with no parabens or phthalates. This gentle gel cleanser has hydrating coconut water with moringa and mango that feels incredibly refreshing and leaves my skin feeling so smooth and clean without stripping my natural oils. This lovely gentle cleanser removes my makeup effortlessly and has my face looking refreshed even through my hormonal breakouts. I absolutely recommend this to anyone that suffers with breakouts, clogged pores and needs a facial wash that is hydrating and not harsh at all.
i love the consistency of this cleanser and how refreshing it is!! i've found myself reaching for this cleanser over my other favorites more and more!!

This cleanser is a light gel formula that turns into foam. One pump goes along way. It has a light herbal scent to it. Face feels clean without feeling dry. It you do not mind the light scent, I recommend to give it a try.

I really love how clean my skin feels after using green clean juicy gel cleanser while not over drying. I feel like it adequately removes my makeup and leaves my skin feeling clean and refreshed. It also leaves a soft glow. The smell is refreshing with a slight earthy scent and lather up nicely. The pump gives you a perfect amount of product each time. You won't be disappointed with this cleanser!

Thanks Farmacy for the free gel cleanser! I love the gel base and it still feels like it's really getting in and cleansing my skin even though it doesn't foam. It has a slight clean scent that isn't irritating or overwhelming. I've used it several times and have no complaints.

avis.titre: Solid cleanser, not for sensitive skin
avis.texte: I received this product for free in exchange for my honest review. I'm giving it 4 starts because although it is a nice gel cleanser, it's too fragranced for my sensitive skin. This is true for most Farmacy products for my skin type. It did dry out my face a bit but i repurposed it for a body wash and it was perfect!

avis.titre: Gentle, Refreshing & Perfect For Daily Use .
avis.texte: I've tried a lot of gel cleansers, and this one stands out because it leaves my skin feeling clean without that tight, dry feeling. It has a refreshing texture, a light scent, and works great for my sensitive skin. I love that it removes daily buildup while keeping my skin soft and hydrated. I would definitely buy it again and happily recommend it to my friends and family!

Thanks to Farmacy for the free product! I received the Farmacy Green Clean Juicy Gel Cleanser for free in exchange for my honest review. I have been using it mornings and nights and so far it has worked well with my skin. The packaging is great! I like that it has a pump and is easy to dispense without me needing to grab the whole bottle. I have sensitive skin and it leaves my face feeling clean but not dry or irritated. It works great on its own but I have found that it works the best for me when I use it to double cleanse to remove makeup and sunscreen. It has a light, clean scent, and lathers very well. I dont need a lot of it to get a nice lather going which is great. I'd definitely recommend this, especially for anyone who likes to double cleanse.
Face feels refresh after double cleansing. Doesn't dry out my faces and it smells good.
A little goes a long way. This cleanser didn't make my skin dry or felt like it was stripping it. Refreshing and clean.

I was gifted the Pharmacy Green Clean Juicy Gel Cleanser by Farmacy Beauty and have really been enjoying it! It creates a soft, refreshing lather that leaves my skin feeling clean without that tight, stripped feeling. My skin feels hydrated and smooth after every wash! It is definitely a gentle cleanser but it actually does a great job at removing any leftover makeup. I've been using both morning and night with no breakouts!

This cleanser is gentle but effective. I have very sensitive skin which is prone to over stripping- this cleanser was very gentle but also very effective - it left my face feeling squeaky clean without over stripping or over cleansing. The smell is akin to being in a high end spa. I very much recommend this cleanser!

It really delivers on its promises; it works well on the skin and doesn't cause irritation or dryness. I liked the way it made my skin feel. The only thing I didn't like was the fragrance. I will continue using it.

Farmacy Green Clean Juicy Gel cleanser works well for my combination skin. It's light and when mixed with water does a great job cleansing my skin. It does not produce a tight feeling on my skin afterwards. I also like that it has a subtle pleasant scent as well.
My new favorite cleanser! Smells nice and leaves my skin feeling soft and clean.
This has become a staple in my skincare routine day and night. My skin feels soft and deeply clean. Since I started using Farmacy green clean my skin looks healthier and has a natural glow.

I think this is a decent cleanser. It has a light refreshing scent, and cleans very well. However, my skin does feel mildly tight after which for me indicates its drying my skin a bit more than I care for. But on those days where I need to clean off heavier things like sunscreen or lots of makeup, this is a great option.

I received Green Clean Juicy Gel Cleaner to try for free for my honest feedback. I have been using it faithfully since it came in the mail and I can say it is now my favorite cleanser. It smells amazing, has a great lather and leaves my face so smooth after rinsing. I won't be going back to my previous cleanser.
This cleanser is incredibly gentle. Even after I had sunburned my skin, I started using it, and it was not harsh on my skin. I used it every single day.

I received the Green Clean Juicy Gel Cleanser as a complimentary gift from BuzzAgent in exchange for trying it, and I'm so thankful for the opportunity! After using it, I really enjoyed how lightweight and refreshing the gel formula feels on my skin. It creates a gentle lather that effectively removes dirt, oil, and everyday buildup without leaving my face feeling stripped or dry. My skin felt clean, soft, and refreshed after each wash, and I appreciated how gentle it was for daily use. I'm grateful to BuzzAgent for sending me this product to experience, and I'm happy I had the chance to discover a cleanser that leaves my skin feeling fresh and comfortable. Thank you, BuzzAgent, for this thoughtful gift!

avis.titre: Definitely on my will buy again list
avis.texte: I love this face cleanser. It has a light scent, almost eucalyptus like, not overwhelming at all. It suds up nicely and rinses away clean. Skin is left cleansed and not stripped or dry like so many other cleansers. I'm a big fan and will be repurchasing.

avis.titre: I would buy this product 1,000 times over
avis.texte: I am a sucker for a good cleanser and this one fits the bill. Not only does it smell incredible, but I felt like it got my skin nice and clean. I didn't fell sticky or gross after using it and I didn't break out.
I enjoy how gentle this is on my skin and leaves me feeling moisturized
